name: AI Sapiens K0
summary: ROBOTIS returning to open humanoid hardware two decades after DARwIn-OP, this time at full research scale. K0 publishes its bill of materials, CAD, source and simulation assets, and runs on the company's new Dynamixel-Q quasi-direct-drive actuators — high back-drivability and torque control, the properties learned policies need on real hardware.
notable: Fully open hardware: BoM, CAD, source and sim assets
First platform for the Dynamixel-Q quasi-direct-drive actuator

sources.title: ROBOTIS enters the open-source humanoid arena with AI Sapiens K0 — Humanoids Daily
